description: Run DNS lookups for up to 200 domains in a single call. Emulated bulk (no native upstream endpoint): the server fans out single lookups concurrently and returns a unified envelope, 1 credit per input. Use this whenever you have ≥2 domains and want concurrent execution under one rate-limit budget. For >200 inputs, split client-side. Do NOT use this for historical DNS records (use `dns_history`) or for a single domain (use `dns_lookup` directly).

confirm.description: Pass true to run a call estimated at over 100 credits, once the user has agreed to that cost.

domain_names.description: Domain names to look up (1 credit per domain, max 200 per call).

query_type.description: Comma-separated DNS query types (A, MX, NS, SOA, etc.) or "all". Applied uniformly to all inputs.

name: bulk_dns_lookup
